# Your status page should not go down with your app.

> A free, self-hosted status page with uptime monitoring, 90-day bars, incidents, maintenance windows and alerts. An source-available alternative to Statuspage, Instatus and Better Stack. MIT, zero dependencies.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
